items: ArtifactData is deferred: ToolSearch 'select:ArtifactData' first.
A NOT RUN tool result means nothing happened. Repeat the call.
ArtifactData update merges objects but replaces arrays whole. Writes to existing docs need if_version. Batch entries can take file_path to JSON files, which saves retyping big docs.
Artifact 'list' and list_triggers show everything on the account. Check them when the catalog or schedules might be stale.
Artifact read with path 'index.html' saves a page to a file; files over ~16 KB stay out of context, smaller ones come back inline too. A Docs-type artifact's index.html is only the editor shell.
Eastern offset: -04:00 until Nov 1, 2026, then -05:00 until Mar 14, 2027.

The log page source starts at <title>; publishing adds the skeleton. Republishing from a new chat can be refused twice with the live HTML attached; if the file already covers it, the third send goes through.
To test a page: python3 -m kit.qa page.html --mock m.json (kit.qa.mock_from_dump turns an ArtifactData list dump into the mock). It supersedes harness/render.py.
New scheduled tasks get the account's connectors (Spotify, Claude Docs) attached, and update_trigger can't detach them. Only the prompt keeps a task out of personal apps.

Shell network (Oct 12, 1:29pm, after the user changed the web Capabilities setting): the open web works from the shell through the proxy (curl, requests, pandas URLs; raw.githubusercontent.com too). pip and npm work only via the proxy, because the registries sit on NO_PROXY and direct DNS fails. Strip them first: NP=$(echo "$NO_PROXY" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -vE '^(pypi.org|files.pythonhosted.org|registry.npmjs.org)$' | paste -sd,); NO_PROXY=$NP no_proxy=$NP pip install --break-system-packages X. For npm also pass --noproxy='' --https-proxy="$HTTPS_PROXY". Installed pyarrow 26 this way. Installs last only for the session; bootstrap.sh does all this. Confirmed still open in a second chat, Oct 12 2:53pm. A 403 from the proxy is policy: report it, never route around it. Reasons: curl -sS "$HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status".

Network settings: the claude.ai/code cloud environment setting (Full, 12:54 Oct 12) changed nothing here. What opened egress was the user changing Settings → Capabilities on claude.ai web around 1:28pm (presumably 'Allow network egress'; the mobile app has no such option), and it reached this running chat within a minute. Source: support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783. Unconfirmed whether scheduled runs get the same access. Never add or reach a site WebFetch refused.
WebFetch reads RSS feeds and returns short JSON verbatim, but refuses some sites (blocked, robots.txt, errors). Never route around a refusal. It reports redirects instead of following them.
An artifact can carry a helper file: publish with files {"desk.py": {from, contentType: "text/plain"}}, then any session gets it with Artifact read path 'desk.py'.

GitHub setup took three steps: link the account in claude.ai connectors (fiddly on mobile), create the repo (sessions can't create repos), and install the Claude GitHub App on the account for pushes. Repo names are case-insensitive in add_repo but list_repos shows the real one. Sessions are bound to attached repos; /user endpoints other than 'gh api user' are refused.

Open-web sources that worked from the shell on Oct 12: raw.githubusercontent.com (Natural Earth geojson), nlftp.mlit.go.jp (Japan's national GIS data, e.g. N02 railways), s3.amazonaws.com elevation-tiles-prod (Terrarium tiles, includes bathymetry), arbitrary PDFs. Rate-limited on the shared egress IP: Wikipedia API and Open-Meteo (429; one retry after 30s worked once). overpass-api.de resets the tunnel; don't retry.

Before publishing numbers, re-derive every claim on the page from the saved results. On Oct 12 that caught an overclaim (I wrote that bridge-covering beat the paper's best simulation; its alpha was 0.66 vs 0.7).

Long Python sweeps: run workers with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 under multiprocessing (2 cores), cache results per config so a restart resumes, and save raw arrays so metrics can be re-scored after a fix. pkill -f with the script name kills the calling shell too; kill by PID.
Artifact types on this account (Oct 12): Dashboard, Design, Design System, Docs, Slides. Decks, docs, designs and dashboards start from these, not hand-built HTML.

Artifact runtime capabilities available (contract 0.2.75): artifact (page republishes itself), assets, comments, db, downloads, files, mcp (a page calls the viewer's connectors; host:claude_browser lets it read other sites, only in a Cowork desktop session), room (live presence), sample (page asks Claude, on the viewer's usage), user. Load the artifact-capabilities skill before using any.

Shared egress IP limits (Oct 12): OpenAlex's keyless budget is exhausted (free key needed), Semantic Scholar 429, Wikipedia REST 429, BLS daily quota, GDELT 429, CourtListener 125/day, MusicBrainz 503 under load. Keys needed: Census, Congress.gov, EIA. 403 to bots: SEC (wants a contact email in the UA), Reddit, TechPowerUp. Crossref, Europe PMC, arXiv, PubMed, FRED, World Bank, IMF, OWID, Eurostat, ECB, OECD, Treasury, Comtrade and Wikidata all answer.
arXiv's API returns zero results if a stopword like 'of' is an all: term; kit.scholar.arxiv strips them. Europe PMC's citation sort matches full text unless terms are wrapped in TITLE_ABS.
